name: VisualWebArena
summary: MIT benchmark of 910 multimodal visual web tasks for agents, extending WebArena with visually grounded sites and evaluation scripts.
description: Established 2024 research release (web-arena-x/visualwebarena; MIT; not archived; last push observed 2024-11), not a new 2026 product. Website https://jykoh.com/vwa and paper arXiv:2401.13649. README documents 910 VWA tasks, local Python 3.10/3.11 setup (not 3.12), Playwright, optional AMI, and a demo for running on arbitrary webpages. Live-site or environment interactions can have real-world side effects; model APIs are separate.

agent_access.notes: Public repository and project site; local environment setup per README. Arbitrary-site demo runs can have real-world side effects.
